This case gives one root: \(-4\)

\( -x^2 - 4x - 3 +2x + 5 = 0 \\ \Rightarrow x^2 + 2x - 2 = 0 \\ \Rightarrow x = -1 \pm \sqrt{3} \)

Checking for \(x^2 + 4x + 3 < 0\), \( -1 + \sqrt 3 \) doesn't satisfy. So, discarded.

This case also gives other root. \( -1 - \sqrt{3} \)

So, there are two roots.
